name: Atarka
description: Atarka is one of the five elder dragons of Tarkir, a hungry antlered predator who became dragonlord of the Temur.

description_citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
description_citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

summary.text: Atarka is one of the five elder dragons of Tarkir, a hungry antlered predator who became dragonlord of the Temur.

bio.text: Atarka arrived with her brood's storms, which caused the Melting Wilds, and she conquered Qadat, winning over its efreet.

citations.text: "Qal Sisma", section "Historical". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Commune with Lava (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: In the Khans of Tarkir timeline, Yasova fed Atarka mammoth carcasses, which saved the Temur from attack.

citations.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

bio.text: Atarka's arrival melted the Qal Sisma glaciers, and she wiped out the mammoths and most of the former Temur shamans.

citations.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citations.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

bio.text: As dragonlord she demanded regular meat offerings, and her Hunt Caller Surrak fed her.

citations.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.
"The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

bio.text: In Chronicle of Bolas, Atarka confronted Yasova's hunting band but spared them after Tae Jin's vision of Nicol Bolas impressed her.

citations.text: "Atarka", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citations.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citations.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

bio.text: In the Dragonstorm timeline, she purged the whisperers and made the Temur a clan dedicated to feeding her.

citations.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

bio.text: Rebels and whisperers combined forces to defeat Atarka and the other dragonlords, and spirit dragons defeated the dragonlords, who were swallowed by the storm.

citations.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Revival of the Temur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
"Atarka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

status.text: Atarka was defeated in the Dragonstorm timeline and her tyranny was expunged from Temur lands, with the Temur toppling an effigy of it.

citations.text: "Atarka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
Heritage Reclamation (Tarkir: Dragonstorm, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Atarka arrives with her brood's storms, causing the Melting Wilds, and conquers Qadat.
timeline.quote: the arrival of Atarka and the storms that birthed her brood were accompanied by widespread melting of the icy reaches in the Qal Sisma Mountains

citation.text: "Qal Sisma", section "Historical". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Atarka eats the Temur clan's whisperers during her rule, leaving only hunters; after her overthrow the whisperers return.
timeline.quote: During her rule, dragonlord Atarka ate the clan's whisperers, leaving only hunters.

citation.text: "Shaman", section "Whisperers". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the current timeline Yasova's efforts instead cause Ugin to slumber, creating more dragons; after failing to unite the khans she appeals to Atarka and feeds her.
timeline.quote: Yasova was forced to try to appeal to Atarka, the leader of the dragon brood infesting Temur territory

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Atarka purges the whisperers, stripping the Temur of their identity and reorganizing survivors into a clan dedicated to feeding her.
timeline.quote: Atarka initiated a purge of the whisperers, fearing their elemental magic

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yasova surrenders to Atarka when Bolas's plans fail.
timeline.quote: When their plans failed, Yasova had no choice but to surrender to Atarka.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Over millennia, Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon revered by a clan.
timeline.quote: Over the millennia, the spirit dragon Ugin's magic coalesced into powerful storms on his native plane of Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova feeds Atarka mammoth carcasses to distract the dragons from the Temur; the dragons later purge shamans.
timeline.quote: Yasova satiated her hunger by feeding her mammoth carcasses

citation.text: "Atarka", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eighteen years after the Khanfall Atarka confronts Yasova's hunting band; Tae Jin's vision of Bolas saves them.
timeline.quote: The band were only saved because Tae Jin had a vision of Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Atarka", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yasova leads her warriors to Ayagor and feeds a mammoth to Atarka as a gift, asking to stop fighting.
timeline.quote: I don't want to fight you anymore. I'm tired of fighting. That was a gift. Spare us, and there will be more.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Yasova carves an ivory image of the Temur offering meat to Atarka and says the future is not yet written.
timeline.quote: The future isn't yet written," she said. "It's up to us to write it, together.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: The Khanfall: each khan falls and their clans with them; five dragon clans rise under the dragonlords.
timeline.quote: one by one, each of the ancient humanoid khans fell, and their clans fell with them

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Atarka's arrival and storms melt the Qal Sisma glaciers, and she wipes out the mammoths and most of the former Temur shamans.
timeline.quote: Atarka quickly devoured most of the shamans of the former Temur clan

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: The surviving Atarka shamans secretly warn each other through the Wide Whisper as Atarka's purge begins.
timeline.quote: As the dragon's purge began, the shamans warned each other secretly

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 2". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Atarka conquers Qadat, the Fire Rim, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire.
timeline.quote: Atarka conquered Qadat, the Fire Rim, long ago, winning over its efreet with a promise to spread the glory of fire to all the world.

citation.text: Commune with Lava (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: A shaman opens the earth and traps survivors in the crevices of Ayagor for Atarka to devour.
timeline.quote: The shaman opened the earth beneath their feet, trapping the survivors within the crevices of Ayagor for Atarka to devour at her leisure.

citation.text: Seismic Rupture (Dragons of Tarkir, 2015), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Yasova feeds Atarka mammoth carcasses, saving the Temur from attack.
timeline.quote: Yasova satiated her hunger by feeding her mammoth carcasses

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebellions grow under Atarka's cruel rule and surviving whisperers emerge from hiding to galvanize them.
timeline.quote: many remaining whisperers emerged from hiding.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Revival of the Temur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rebels and whisperers combine forces to defeat Atarka and the other dragonlords.
timeline.quote: their combined might led to Atarka's defeat alongside the other dragonlords.

citation.text: "Temur Frontier", section "Revival of the Temur". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The hunting horn sounds across the mountains and a family of hidden ainok rise to answer it.
timeline.quote: The horn sounds, and they walk.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Surrak delivers the offering to Atarka at the Ayagor with the traditional words.
timeline.quote: Great Atarka, dragonlord and protector. This is a gift. Spare us, and there will be more.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Surrak's second tells Atarka that Surrak killed one of her brood; Atarka says 'Take care of it,' and Surrak defeats the second when he attacks with a knife.
timeline.quote: With a burst of speed, Surrak slammed his fist into his second's ribs, cracking several, and sending the knife clattering along the stone.

citation.text: "The Call" by Nik Davidson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset goes to speak to Ugin and plans to study Atarka's ivory histories, content to stay on Tarkir for now; Sarkhan agrees.
timeline.quote: But this world has secrets enough. For right now…I'm right where I want to be.

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan emerges in Tarkir's past, sees Atarka and Yasova, and realizes he has traveled back in time.
timeline.quote: He realizes the truth: he has traveled into Tarkir's past

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Dragons melt the snow with fire and flood the valley, and Naiva worries what she will do if Grandmother is dead.
timeline.quote: People who wouldn't just turn her twin over to Atarka once they discovered she was a shaman.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Baishya addresses her grandmother as Yasova Dragonclaw, a name Atarka has banned, and slips into a whisper trance.
timeline.quote: Atarka had banished the name Dragonclaw and eaten every person who had dared use the term in her presence.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Three of Atarka's broodlings land at the camp demanding the clan surrender its shamans.
timeline.quote: We smell magic in the air. Surrender your shamans to us, or we will kill you all.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The Twins" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Naiva tends Tae Jin's wound and learns he left his mother at twelve; she reveals Atarka killed her own mother for being a whisperer.
timeline.quote: Our mother is dead. Atarka killed her for being a whisperer.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: A dragon tempest passes over the camp; Atarka arrives, finds her dead broodling, and drives the newborn dragons back into the storm.
timeline.quote: Slashing and raging, she drove the fledglings deeper into the night.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Atarka lands between the hunting band and the shelter, seizes Darka, and eats him.
timeline.quote: She bit off Darka's head before tossing his body in a high arc.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova tells Atarka that Ojutai's kin killed her broodling and that the hunters have killed the outsider as a feast for her.
timeline.quote: One of Ojutai's kin killed your broodling and fed on its innards.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Atarka forces the party to follow her to the corpse and spots Tae Jin as an outsider smelling of Ojutai.
timeline.quote: He smells of Ojutai, that pompous, ice-breathing windbag.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Yasova claims Tae Jin has come to serve Atarka and stops him from raising his ghostfire blade.
timeline.quote: Do not begin that which you cannot end.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Atarka agrees to hear a story while she eats the Ojutai dragon before deciding Tae Jin's fate.
timeline.quote: Tell a story while I feast. Then I decide.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin begins a story but it twists, and he mutters that it isn't the story he meant to tell.
timeline.quote: That isn't the story I meant to tell. Let me try again.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Atarka declares there is only one law, to eat, and spares Tae Jin before flying off.
timeline.quote: There is only one law: to eat. This was a good feast. You may keep the outsider.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Blood and Fire" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: Atarka conquers Qadat, winning over its efreet.
timeline.quote: Atarka conquered Qadat, the Fire Rim, long ago

citation.text: Commune with Lava (Commander 2020, 2020), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The invasion's casualties weaken the dragonlords and rebellions gain traction.
timeline.quote: sufficiently weakened the dragonlords' grip on power

citation.text: "Atarka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Spirit dragons defeat the dragonlords, who are swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm

citation.text: "Atarka", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Patrons from different clans quarrel over which rebellion leader was the real hero, while illusions of the dragonlords roar out of the smoke.
timeline.quote: snake-headed Silumgar, Atarka with her crown of antlers, spined Kolaghan, Dromoka shining like the sun, and of course, feathered Ojutai

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Temur topple an effigy of Atarka's tyranny.
timeline.quote: With an echoing crash the effigy fell, the symbol of Atarka's tyranny expunged from Temur lands.

citation.text: Heritage Reclamation (Tarkir: Dragonstorm, 2025), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Atarka confronts the hunting band but is impressed by Tae Jin's vision of Nicol Bolas, sparing them.
timeline.quote: They were only saved because Tae Jin had a vision of Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Baishya", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After her hunting group is attacked by one of Atarka's brood, Eshki escapes into the mountains and meets Alniul.
timeline.quote: When her hunting group was attacked by one of Atarka's brood and left for dead, Eshki had enough.

citation.text: "Eshki", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yasova appeased Atarka with a sacrifice of wild animals.
timeline.quote: she might appease Atarka

citation.text: "Khanfall", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yasova's band fled the Atarka dragons and set out to find the Crucible of the Spirit Dragon.
timeline.quote: the band of Yasova fled the Atarka dragons

citation.text: "Naiva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin's vision of Nicol Bolas impressed Atarka and saved the band.
timeline.quote: They were only saved because Tae Jin had a vision of Nicol Bolas

citation.text: "Naiva", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In the current timeline Surrak kills and eats an interfering dragon, and Atarka spares him.
timeline.quote: she spared Surrak after he killed and ate the interfering dragon

citation.text: "Surrak", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Ugin surviving, Yasova surrenders to Atarka by feeding her a mammoth carcass.
timeline.quote: Yasova had no choice but to surrender to

citation.text: "Yasova", section "Khanfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Yasova forsakes her title and hides her dragon claw staff, giving a fake to Atarka.
timeline.quote: Yasova had to forsake her honorary title.

citation.text: "Yasova", section "Looking for Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Atarka confronts the band and is impressed by Tae Jin's vision of Nicol Bolas.
timeline.quote: the hunting band was confronted by Atarka herself

citation.text: "Yasova", section "Looking for Ugin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
